1: ## 1. Phase 1 — `FlashDevice` trait + `FlashError` enum
2:

5: - [ ] 1.3 `fs/src/flash/error.rs` — `FlashError` enum + POSIX errno conversion

17: ## 3. Phase 3 — littlefs v2.x read path
18: 
19: - [ ] 3.1 `fs/src/flash/littlefs/superblock.rs` — superblock parser, format-version check, refuse non-v2.x
20: - [ ] 3.2 `fs/src/flash/littlefs/metadata.rs` — metadata-pair reader (committed-half selection)
21: - [ ] 3.3 `fs/src/flash/littlefs/dir.rs` — directory entry iteration
22: - [ ] 3.4 `fs/src/flash/littlefs/file.rs` — file inline data + CTZ block list reader

29: ## 4. Phase 4 — littlefs v2.x write path
30:

37: - [ ] 4.7 Property-based fuzz on write sequences

39: ## 5. Phase 5 — fsync + metadata-pair commit semantics
40: 
41: - [ ] 5.1 `fs/src/flash/littlefs/fsync.rs` — `fsync(fd)` triggers metadata-pair commit
42: - [ ] 5.2 No background timer commit (different from F2FS — flash wear cost is too high)
43: - [ ] 5.3 Power-fail tests: kill-9 mid-write → mock simulates partial program → mount → verify last fsync intact
44: - [ ] 5.4 Kani harness for metadata-pair commit atomicity invariant
45: - [ ] 5.5 Tests for fadvise SEQUENTIAL write-batching behavior
46: 
47: ## 6. Phase 6 — Wear-leveling + Bad Block Table
48: 
49: - [ ] 6.1 `fs/src/flash/littlefs/alloc.rs` — block allocator integrating BBT skip
50: - [ ] 6.2 BBT readers/writers at start AND end of flash (duplicated)
51: - [ ] 6.3 Both-BBT-corrupt halt path
52: - [ ] 6.4 Single-BBT-corrupt recovery path (rewrite from surviving copy)
53: - [ ] 6.5 Runtime-detected bad block path (program/erase failure → mark bad → update both BBTs → continue)
54: - [ ] 6.6 1M-cycle stress on mock validates per-block erase distribution within 5% of mean
55: - [ ] 6.7 TLA+ model `littlefs_wear.tla` proves wear-leveling progress invariant
56: - [ ] 6.8 Coq proof of BBT redundancy (loss of either copy survives)

58: ## 7. Phase 7 — `/flash/` mount
59: 
60: - [ ] 7.1 Extend `posix-vfs` with `/flash/` mount point
61: - [ ] 7.2 Conditional compilation: feature off → no /flash/ in path tree
62: - [ ] 7.3 Boot-time mount sequence: flash device discovery → BBT load → littlefs mount
63: - [ ] 7.4 Coexistence with `/data/` F2FS mount (both available, distinct purposes)
64: - [ ] 7.5 Flash-only target: canonical `auth/`/`audit/`/`mgmt/` under /flash/
65: - [ ] 7.6 First-boot directory tree creation per `mgmt-config-layout`
66: - [ ] 7.7 Format-on-physical-presence path (mirrors F2FS first-boot logic)
67: - [ ] 7.8 Boot-cleanup: littlefs orphan recovery on mount

69: ## 8. Phase 8 — Per-arch QSPI/ONFI driver stubs
70: 
71: - [ ] 8.1 `arch/aarch64/src/flash/qspi.rs` — QSPI NOR controller binding stub (TODO when first MCU/FPGA target arrives)
72: - [ ] 8.2 `arch/aarch64/src/flash/onfi.rs` — ONFI NAND controller binding stub
73: - [ ] 8.3 `arch/riscv64/src/flash/qspi.rs` — QSPI stub
74: - [ ] 8.4 `arch/riscv64/src/flash/onfi.rs` — ONFI stub
75: - [ ] 8.5 Documentation: `docs/embedded-flash-fs.md` operator runbook (format choice, BBT semantics, fadvise hints, recovery via littlefs-fuse)

77: ## CHECKPOINT — Two PRs into `develop`
78: 
79: This change ships as **two PRs**:
80: 
81: - **PR 1 (this PR — scaffolding only):** proposal.md, design.md, the 5 spec deltas (3 new + 2 modified), tasks.md. Merges to `develop` so agent teams can spawn worktrees off develop and pick up the design.
82: - **PR 2 (later — implementation):** all 8 phases in one cohesive merge, behind the default-off `fs-flash` cargo feature. Per-arch QSPI/ONFI bringup ships as documented stubs only; full hardware bringup happens when the first MCU/FPGA target arrives.

102: - [ ] CB.10 `cargo audit` / `cargo deny` clean

104: ## 9. Cross-phase verification
